svg.title: The flock read on the 600-cell
svg.desc: Left: the 600-cell's 120 vertices in the H4 Coxeter plane with faint edges. One query token sits at its home vertex (orange) with its 12 adjacent vertices outlined in blue; seven of them, the kept earlier tokens, are filled and circled. Right: in the query's frame, the seven kept tokens are turned by the query's conjugate and added head to tail into one consensus vector (vermilion), and the query's own vector bends toward it, before dotted and after solid. Inset: the live integer version uses 16 frame roots; the summed vector snaps to the nearest root and a three-position dial adds, skips or subtracts it. Geometry is computed; which seven are kept is illustrative.
svg.text: Read a few nearby earlier tokens, turn each into the query's frame, and move toward their consensus.
each kept token is turned by q̄ (query conjugate)
7 turned arrows, added head to tail
the live integer version uses 16 frame roots
600-cell geometry computed (H4 Coxeter plane); which 7 neighbours are kept is illustrative.
The 600-cell picture is the earlier float-era form; the live version uses 16 frame roots.
